entities.name: Karlovy Vary International Film Festival

entities.summary: The Karlovy Vary International Film Festival is an annual film festival held in Karlovy Vary, Czech Republic. The Karlovy Vary Festival is one of the oldest in the world and has become the leading film event in Central Europe.
